edition_config.description: Edition configuration of the Storage Intelligence resource. Valid values are INHERIT, DISABLED, TRIAL and STANDARD.
edition_config.rationale: Setting edition_config to DISABLED removes Storage Intelligence monitoring at the organization level, eliminating security visibility, anomaly detection, and compliance monitoring across ALL folders, projects and buckets within the organization. This has a wider blast radius than folder or project level. Storage Intelligence must remain active to maintain security coverage.

name.description: Identifier of the GCP Organization. For GCP org, this field should be organization number.
name.rationale: This is a required identifier field used to reference the GCP Folder. It does not control any security behaviour or access permissions.

filter.description: Filter over location and bucket using include or exclude semantics. Resources that match the include or exclude filter are exclusively included or excluded from the Storage Intelligence plan.

filter.excluded_cloud_storage_buckets.description: Buckets to exclude from the Storage Intelligence plan.

filter.excluded_cloud_storage_buckets.bu.description: List of bucket id regexes to exclude in the storage intelligence plan.

filter.excluded_cloud_storage_locations.description: Locations to exclude from the Storage Intelligence plan.

filter.included_cloud_storage_buckets.description: Buckets to include in the Storage Intelligence plan.

filter.included_cloud_storage_buckets.bu.description: List of bucket id regexes to exclude in the storage intelligence plan.

filter.included_cloud_storage_locations.description: Locations to include in the Storage Intelligence plan.
